Notes: Shadow School, Stage D1 (ConquestEncounters.cs): the private copy of the Fire School that the hearth binding opens for one Shadow wizard on the quest ShadowSchool-Conquest-Falmea. Only a copy loaded with this variant uses this file; the public Fire School is untouched. From the zone's own gamedata.bin (read on the live server, 2026-10-23): Dalia Falmea (WC-RAV-NPC04, template 38208, the Fire trainer) stands at (787, 9.45, 99.75), facing 1.578; players arrive at Start (-134.3, -23.0, 0.5). In this copy her trainer self is left out (Remove 38208) and the game's own Wizard City Falmea combat template (DaliaFalmea-WCBoss-R7, 403089: Falmea's model, level 7 boss) stands in her place, spawned as Shadow School custom 1880001 (spiraldb/Customs/1880001.json: Fire, level 10, 950 health, a Fire deck, no drops). A Duel Circle (560, CombatSigil8Actor, as the Wizard City boss rooms of Nightshade and Foulgaze use) is on her platform. Every way out of this copy, and a lost or fled battle, goes to Ravenwood outside the Fire School's door (the Ravenwood FireSchool Exit location), never back into this copy.
